narrative: During our college days we met through our mutual friend; she gave her my contact information and she had the gall to make fun of me. Little did she know, I'm a very serious man. Our mutual friend told me to court her. At first I was hesitant, but our friend insisted, so I did. A few months later, I decided to meet her in person, and right there and then I told her I like her and I want to court her. I didn't hear her answer, so I took it as a yes. After four years of hard work, sleepless nights, trying to make her fall in love with me, finally she said yes. Six years later, we decided to get married. Now a new chapter awaits for the both of us, full of love and affection.
